title: Frozen DINOv2 classifier and global-local kernel screen
purpose: Determine whether classifier geometry, rather than sparse-part evidence, is the current performance bottleneck before spending GPU time on representation fine-tuning.

inputs.features: Frozen official DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS and mean-patch features cached by PAT-H-260729-001

selection_rule.screen_success: best arm improves by at least 0.50 percentage points
selection_rule.confirmation: Any selected arm remains exploratory until evaluated unchanged on episodes 2 and 3.
